subject: Model-type corrections landed: coordinate-led EBM + QL/MEF Jev, both live-verified with first results
result: Owner corrections applied to experiments/model-types and both corrected runnables are now LIVE with first results. (1) SCHEMA CORRECTION: the bimba_schema relation-type vocabulary is out of line (owner-confirmed) — structure now comes from the coordinate grammar itself; field_probe.py mirrors the operative parser (bimba-portable/src/coordinates/parser.ts: CPMSLT type letters, multi-digit segments, -/. descent, context frames, prime marker, # -> M family). LIVE RERUN (2000 pairs/operator, seed 20260917): separation ladder by corruption operator — endpoint-rewire (different root) lineage 0.841 / combined 0.846; hard-rewire (same root) 0.631 / 0.634; sibling-rewire (same parent) 0.515 / 0.519 — nearly blind, the measured specification of what the Phase-2 learned head must add; direction-reversal 0.5 by construction (pair potentials direction-blind). Coordinate-led roughly doubled coarse separation vs the vacuous declared-type attempt (0.59 -> 0.85). Evidence: ebm/evidence/field-probe-20260917-212000.json. Cheapest upgrade: run bimba_embed batch (no vectors found in-graph; semantic readout is lexical fixture-grade) then re-run. (2) JEV RESCOPED to QL/MEF lensing and classification per owner; census/m-ledger work removed entirely. build_states.py now builds ql-position states from the retained ql-condition runs (act source_position = loop-recorded truth, declared standing) and mef-lens-refraction readings over the 12 MEF lenses (no ground truth by design — MEF is disclosure not buckets; reported as mass on the runtime standing L1+L4 refraction pair = agreement-of-readings). LIVE RESULT (100 acts, model jev-latest): ql-position 92% accuracy (chance 16.7%), Brier 0.212, confidence 0.658; lens-refraction 0.867 mean mass on standing L1+L4 pair; latency p50 238ms / p90 325ms / max 914ms; 117K input + 19K output tokens. Run record: jev/runs/jev-run-2026-09-17T20-18-45-246Z.json (digest-pinned, pending-human-review, promotion none). Honest limits: 92% is against loop-recorded positions not human-verified truth; the QL kernel classify-relation operation (native-owner-instrument, owner rev 08d14e8) is the formal-ground-truth path — wiring it is the named next step. (3) TYPESAFE SKILL vendored at experiments/model-types/jev/skill/typesafe-ai (github.com/typesafe-ai/skills rev 65a39f3) — its law (code owns the workflow; model supplies programmable common sense) is lifted one level into the pairing law now stated in the READMEs: LLM owns semantics (generation, reflection), Jev owns typed classification across QL positions and MEF lenses, Rust owns rules/budgets/execution.
